remarks: Beautifully maintained home in a sought-after family neighborhood, just 4 minutes from the Springdale Metro-North Station and only one hour from New York City. Designed for today's lifestyle, this inviting residence offers exceptional comfort and flow for everyday living and effortless entertaining. A spacious, sun-filled great room with cathedral ceilings, skylights, and a wood-burning stove serves as the heart of the home. The beautifully landscaped, fenced backyard provides privacy and features a potential pool site-perfect for outdoor gatherings or quiet relaxation. Additional highlights include central air conditioning, hardwood floors, a whole-house generator, finished basement, main-floor laundry room, workshop, and storage shed. Ideally located close to shopping, restaurants, and all the conveniences of Springdale village.
